2. It is submitted by counsel for applicant that after the amendment in the provisions of Motor Vehicles Act, the Claim Tribunal should not have applied the principle of "pay and recover".
3. Heard the learned counsel for applicant.
4.

This Court in the case of Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Company Ltd. Registered Office Hari Nivas Towers Vs. Munni Bai and others decided on 11/03/2025 in MA No.5819/2024 (Gwalior) has held that even after amendment in the provisions of Motor Vehicles Act, still the principle of "pay and recover" can still be made applicable 5.
